note: Owner decisions 18 Nov 2026: GCO opens 14 Sep 2028; it uses the weather recorded in 2025 (ECMWF ERA5 reanalysis via Open-Meteo), and the weather must keep evolving realistically for the whole campaign. Layers, finest first: 1-degree tiles over five chokepoints and a 4-degree GCO grid for the opening week; then the 'season': an 8-degree global grid in 14-day chunks covering a full year per source year. Campaign year 1 (Sep 2028-Sep 2029) replays Sep 2025-Sep 2026; year 2 replays Sep 2024-Sep 2025; and so on, so a long campaign never repeats a year. Anything not downloaded falls back to the seeded procedural field (sea ice always comes from the NSIDC-calibrated climatology). The world campaign's start was moved to 2028-09-14 on the same day (build_dynamic_campaign.py START). 19 Nov 2026: 19 more chokepoints (registry gates and the Pacific, North Atlantic and Arctic straits), a 2-degree chokepoint layer for the whole campaign year, and polar bands 80-88N and 64-80S at the season resolution. Existing task ids are unchanged, so cached downloads stay valid.
